description: Diagnostic module to investigate why permission_scope signal shows only 3 distinct values across range 30.0-100.0 (WEAK signal per signal_quality_diagnostic). Reads from mcp_signal_scores WHERE signal_type='permission_scope' via ws_query. Outputs diagnostic report listing score distribution, top contributing metadata fields, and specific recommendations for improving discrimination. Does NOT modify any data. Companion module only; does not replace any protected file. Per spec section 10, propose companion module when protected file behavior needs investigation.
